description: Use before writing SQL, to see which tables exist when a question needs data the other tools do not cover. Returns every queryable table, grouped by schema, with estimated row counts. Schemas: public (GSWA assays, training sites, geophysics vectors), source (DMIRS distilled -- drillholes, tenements, geology, company_dh_intervals, plus 4800+ dasc_* mirror layers), derived (prospectivity grid), mdhdb_raw (the verbatim GSWA MDHDB, 60 gswa_* tables of raw per-element assays with lab methods).
name: sql_tables
title: List SQL tables
